keyLimits.en: Up to 9 active clients, no team contributors, 800 AI credits/month, 900 workflow actions/month, 100 GB storage
Unlimited active clients, up to 30 team contributors, 2,500 AI credits/month, 5,500 workflow actions/month, 500 GB storage
Unlimited clients and contributors, 10,000 AI credits/month, 50,000 workflow actions/month, 2 TB storage, white-labeling and SSO

cautions.en: The Core plan caps active clients at 9 and includes no team contributors, so a growing freelance practice or small team quickly needs Pro.

capabilities.en: All-in-one client work management: projects, tasks, invoicing, proposals and contracts in one platform.
Client portal for shared visibility on projects, files and invoices.
AI assistant ("Plutio Pal") for proposal writing, contract generation and project planning, metered by monthly AI credits.

limitations.en: The entry Core plan supports no team contributors, so it only fits a solo freelancer.
Active client count is capped on Core (9 clients), forcing an upgrade as a client base grows.

reason.en: Direct all-in-one competitor combining CRM, project management, invoicing and client portal.
Covers the proposal and contract part of the same freelance workflow.
Freelancer/small agency client management platform with similar scope.

unknowns: Whether unsubscribed accounts keep read-only access to past data ("limited-free mode") beyond the trial was not fully detailed on the pricing page.
